id: title:jonmcwest:re resolve relative time ranges when refreshing

review.posthog_relevance: Frontend session state and query execution reliability
review.reason: The change replaces a local, incorrect date-parsing implementation with an app-wide parser and adds a refresh action to re-read the current clock, preventing the use of stale cached values in query execution. This improves the correctness and reliability of the frontend's ability to interpret and execute HogQL queries based on the current session time, rather than relying on a now-
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the correctness of the replacement parser and the necessity of the refresh action, which are not independently verified by the provided observations. No tests or rollback checks are cited. The score is assigned based on the removal of a known incorrect implementation and the addition of a refresh mechanism, but the actual runtime behavior and complete test set

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of implementation and checks, not just observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new action refreshWindowAnchor and its invocation, and a new state field windowAnchorMs, while removing a local, incorrect date-parsing map and its regex, replacing it with an app-wide parser.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the tracing filters to re-read the current clock when an explicit refresh occurs, rather than using a stale cached value.
